text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + latency observed from eu-central-1 affecting Hosted API and Dedicated pools. Symptoms: token-exchange failures to third-party auth (token.example.com) -> 502/504. Auto-detection: auth error rate > 12% over last 2m. Pager: @oncall-lee. Bridge: TBD.

oncall-lee: on it. Can someone confirm scope (hosted vs dedicated pools by customer/region)? Any immediate mitigations?

infra-ryan: quick findings: our outbound calls to auth-token.eu.example.com are returning 502s and some 504s. Errors spike started ~3579989900.
Kibana snippet:
```
# errors over last 10m
service:auth-client AND region:eu-central-1 AND status:5xx | count: 4.1k
p50 latency: 920ms, p95: 2.4s
```
Curl repro: `curl -v https://auth-token.eu.example.com/oauth/token -d "grant_type=client_credentials"` -> HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway

sre-maria: probable upstream auth provider degradation (third-party). Options: 1) enable short-lived token caching (serve cached token for 5-15m) for read-heavy routes; 2) route new auth calls to fallback region (eu-west-1) via routing-policy; 3) increase client-side retries with exponential backoff and jitter; 4) temporarily disable non-critical onboarding flows that require fresh token exchange. Recommend (1)+(2) asap.

ops-bot: Creating incident bridge: https://meet.example.com/incident-3579990000 (added). Declaring incident P1. Opening ticket with third-party: <https://status.authvendor.com|AuthVendor status> — referenced case #AV-8921.

support-jordan: Impact: Hosted API requests that require token refresh when token is expired fail with 502 -> customers see 5xx or higher latency. Dedicated pools with short-lived refreshes also impacted. Early list of customers with errors: AcmeCorp, FinPlatform, NotifierInc. Draft support blurb: "We're investigating elevated authentication errors to our eu-central-1 endpoint causing increased latency and some 5xx responses. We're implementing fallback routing and token caching to mitigate. Temporary degraded experience possible. We'll post updates every 15 minutes."

oncall-lee: Doing immediate steps:
- Flip routing policy to enable region-fallback for auth calls (canary 10%).
- Enable token cache TTL=600s for auth-client service.
- Increase retry attempts from 2 -> 4 with backoff 200ms->1s.
Executing now:
```
# enable region fallback (control-plane API)
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/routing/flags -d '{"auth_region_fallback":true, "canary_pct":10}'
```
Response: `{"status":"ok","changed":true}`

infra-ryan: Watch logs for 502 drop after canary. Also confirming that forwarding to eu-west-1 increases RTT ~80ms but success rate should be higher.

sre-maria: Also toggle observability egress rate-limiting for the auth-client to avoid excessive metric spikes filling the egress path: set `obs.sample_rate=0.1` for auth-client for next 30m.

ops-bot: Status page post queued. Will include mitigation steps and ETA placeholders.

oncall-lee: Canary deployed. Initial telemetries: auth 5xx rate down from 12% -> 6% in canary slice. Latency for canary requests ~1.1s. Rolling to 50% in 5m if stable.

support-jordan: Sending targeted notices to impacted customers now (DM & email). Template includes recommended temporary workarounds (retry client side, short caching).

incident-bot: Incident declared P1 at 3579990005. Tags: third-party:authvendor, region:eu-central-1, impact:hosted+deds. Incident channel: #inc-3579990000-bridge.

oncall-lee: Handoff note for next oncall in ~20m (shift change): executed region-fallback canary -> 50% planned. Token caching enabled TTL=600s. Retry backoff increased. Monitoring: error-rate, latency p95, customer error surfacing. Next steps: coordinate with vendor support for full resolution + remove routing rollbacks when vendor confirms stable.

ops-bot: Filed SEV report and attached logs to ticket. Ticket ID: INC-AV-8921.

sre-maria: If vendor confirms sustained outage >30m, plan B: for Dedicated pools we can enable local token proxy that signs short-lived tokens using cached client creds to reduce dependency. That requires ops approval.

oncall-lee: Copy. I'll keep bridge open and escalate to engineering manager if we need plan B. Passing to @oncall-summer for next shift in 20m — please pick up and continue mitigation/communication.

infra-ryan: Observability note: expect partial gaps in metrics during aggressive sampling; keep alert thresholds relaxed by 2x for next 15m to avoid alert storms.

support-jordan: Next update in 15m with customer impact numbers and mitigation status.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Bridge created, Slack channel #inc-3579990000-bridge. Added major stakeholders.

oncall-lee: Thanks all. If you see any regression revert the canary to 10% immediately.

sre-maria: Acks. Monitoring charts: https://dashboards.internal/org/incident/3579990000

incident-bot: Next update scheduled at 3579990900 (+15m).

support-jordan: :thumbsup: updating support tickets and status page now.

oncall-lee: handing off in 18m. leaving detailed playbook in bridge.

ops-bot: Reminder: record timeline in incident doc (runbook -> incidents/3579990000).
